settings.text: One delivery a month, ongoing — pause or cancel anytime.

settings.title: Selected Seasonal
settings.text: A different variety and lot each time.

settings.title: Officially Imported & Managed in the Philippines
settings.text: One trusted local importer handles sourcing, customs, and delivery.

settings.title: Delivery & Freshness
settings.text: Cold-chain handling and a clear schedule so berries arrive at their best.

settings.title: Quality Guarantee
settings.text: If your strawberries arrive less than perfect, we'll make it right.

settings.q: When will the strawberries be delivered?
settings.a: Delivery follows each Japan arrival. Once you reserve, you'll see the exact delivery window — typically 1–2 days after the berries land and clear customs.

settings.q: What happens if the strawberries arrive damaged?
settings.a: Our freshness guarantee covers you: contact us within 24 hours with a photo and we'll arrange a replacement or full refund.
The Ichigo Club delivers once a month, each time a different seasonal variety chosen by the farmers. It continues month to month, and you can pause, skip or cancel anytime from your account.

settings.q: Can I choose the delivery date?
settings.a: Delivery is tied to each Japan arrival to guarantee freshness, but you can select your preferred window at checkout where available.

settings.q: Can I send this as a gift?
settings.a: Yes — the Premium Gift Box is made for it, and you can ship to any address in our delivery area with a personal note.
